node.name: No transaction across a file
node.logic: Each payment is a separate proc call with useAmbientTransaction=false and EnableTransaction=false. A failure in payment n does not roll back payments 1..n-1. BizTalk retry is disabled (RetryCount=0). Duplicate protection, if any, is inside the practice DB procs (not in this repo).
